title: Hopeverse: Villain Wedding Theme v2 (stylish swagger at a grand wedding)
story: A stylish, suave villain makes his slow-motion entry at his own grand wedding.

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct on v1: music fine, but not right for the occasion and not at all a stylish villain. v1 was dark horror; v2 = cool swagger groove (whistle hook, finger snaps, slick melodic bass, twangy veena riff) + a clearly festive, grand wedding band (nadaswaram, thavil, brass), ketti melam climax. Rules 9.1-9.14.

positive_global_styles: a stylish, suave, swaggering villain's theme at his own grand South Indian wedding: cool, confident, groovy and celebratory, composed like a senior blockbuster film composer
slow-motion strut groove, about 90 BPM half-time, heavy and groovy
a catchy whistled 5-note signature hook that becomes the main melody, in a minor scale with Carnatic gamakam slides

balanced fusion: a real festive wedding band (nadaswaram, thavil, brass band) and real veena, mridangam and strings share the spotlight equally with fresh slick electronics (fat synth bass, crisp electronic drums, finger snaps)
a twangy veena riff played like a cool surf guitar, and a slick melodic bass line moving like a second melody

positive_local_styles: the first sound: a metal lighter flick and a cool deep hit
then only two sounds: slow finger snaps and the villain's cool whistled hook
a slick, slow melodic bass groove joins the snaps and the whistle
the festive wedding band enters one layer at a time: thavil, then nadaswaram, then brass swells, all locked to the villain's groove
ends with one full beat of total silence
a massive slam into the slow-motion strut: heavy half-time groove, the twangy veena riff, finger snaps, fat synth bass
the whistle hook now on nadaswaram, confident and stylish
a grand, joyous wedding melody on nadaswaram and brass band with festive thavil, the villain's hook woven inside it
everything steps out except the whistle and the snaps
the ketti melam: a fast, frenzied wedding drum roll on thavil and a racing nadaswaram, as at the tying of the knot, turning into the swagger groove
the hook lifted up a half step, biggest and most stylish
a lone whistled hook, a lighter flick, one final cool hit, then stop
